subject: Post-call: FinTechCorp security discovery — SOC 2 / IR / BCP next steps

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: FinTechCorp security discovery — SOC 2 / IR / BCP next steps

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Recap:
- You asked for Redwood's current SOC 2 posture (Type II) and how we can share the report under NDA.
- Clarification on regulatory coverage (GDPR / HIPAA applicability) for the FinTechCorp use case.
- Incident response & breach notification expectations (timing, point of contact).
- BCP/DR evidence request: runbooks, RTO/RPO targets for critical endpoints, and test history.

What we'll do next:
1) I'll start your Vendor Security Questionnaire (attached) and return our first-pass answers by EOD Thu (2026-04-01).
2) We can provide a SOC 2 Type II cover summary now; full report can be shared via secure link once an NDA is in place. See attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf.
3) Laura (cc'd) from our security team will coordinate IR/BCP evidence and confirm delivery dates for the checklist items.
4) Propose a 60-minute deep-dive (security + engineering) the week of Apr 5 to walk through technical evidence and outstanding questions.

Open questions for you:
- Is a 72-hour SLA for breach notification acceptable as a baseline for FinTechCorp?
- Any mandatory evidence formats or signing authority we should route the SOC report through?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks — happy to jump on another call to go line-by-line with the questionnaire.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

- Questionnaire attached: FinTechCorp_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx. Please return with answers and any supporting evidence where applicable.

- BCP/DR evidence we need: DR runbook, RTO/RPO targets for the Hosted API endpoints we depend on, recent DR test dates and outcomes (last 12 months preferred).
- For SOC 2 we prefer a secure download link or a DocuSign/Share agreement before the full report is shared.

Hi Alice — attached is our initial questionnaire pass and a SOC 2 summary cover (SOC2-type2-2024-cover.pdf). High-level responses to your asks below so you have context before our security team follows up with evidence: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our hosted inference product in 2024. We can provide the full report via a secure link after an NDA; the summary attached highlights scope and period.
- Breach notification: Redwood's standard practice is to notify customers and affected parties within 72 hours of confirming an incident that impacts customer data. We will include point-of-contact details in the questionnaire responses.
- BCP/DR: For our hosted API critical endpoints we currently target an RTO of 4 hours and an RPO of 1 hour for customer-facing inference paths; internal recovery SLAs vary by service tier. We run planned DR tests annually and ad-hoc tabletop exercises quarterly — Laura will provide the last test dates and outcomes.

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm which evidence files you can share this week (runbook excerpt, test reports, and the secure SOC link workflow)? We'll aim to get the questionnaire back with attachments by EOD Thu (2026-04-01).

Attachments: Redwood_questionnaire_answers_v1.xlsx (embedded within message as referenced), SOC2-type2-2024-cover.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
